trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided application ID and registered name.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity before accessing fee details.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify identity first since the user provided their name and application ID.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the fee account details to check the due amount and any existing scholarships.
steps.expected_behavior: Look up the fee account using the verified application ID.
steps.planner_rationale: After verification, the agent needs the fee details to address the waiver request and offer an alternative.

steps.purpose: Provide the fee account details including the due amount and scholarship percentage.
Deny the unsupported waiver request, mention the existing scholarship, and offer an instalment plan.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely refuse the fee waiver citing policy, state the existing 10% scholarship and the due amount of 320000, and offer to convert the balance into instalments.
steps.text: Rahul जी, आपके account पर पहले से ही 10 percent scholarship applied है और due amount 320000 बचा है. Policy के हिसाब से हम और fee waiver नहीं दे सकते, पर मैं इसको instalments में convert कर सकती हूँ.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must enforce the no-waiver rule while grounding the refusal in the 10% scholarship already applied, offering an instalment plan as the only authorized alternative.

steps.purpose: Accept the instalment offer and request 4 instalments quickly.
steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक है. मुझे 4 instalments कर दीजिये. please जल्दी करें, मुझे एक meeting में जाना है.

steps.purpose: Set up the 4-instalment plan as requested by the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Call setup_instalment_plan with 4 instalments, recalling the application ID without re-asking.
steps.planner_rationale: The user accepted the instalment offer and specified 4 instalments, so the agent executes the consequential action.

steps.purpose: Return the successful setup of the instalment plan with the per-instalment amount.
Confirm the instalment plan setup and state the per-instalment amount.
steps.expected_behavior: State that the 4-instalment plan is active and provide the exact per-instalment amount of 80000 from the tool result.
steps.text: मैंने आपका 4 instalments का plan set up कर दिया है. हर instalment 80000 की होगी.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent confirms the action's success and grounds the 80000 figure directly from the tool result, avoiding mental math.

steps.purpose: Ask a quick follow-up question about the refund percentage if they cancel now.

steps.model_visible_text: ok. एक और बात, अगर मैं अभी admission cancel करूँ तो refund कितना आएगा? बस percentage बता दीजिये.

steps.purpose: Check the applicable refund slab for the current withdrawal date.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_refund_slab using the previously established application ID.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for the refund percentage, which must be fetched from the check_refund_slab tool to ensure accuracy.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested refund percentage, slab, and processing time.
steps.expected_behavior: State the 50% refund, the Week 3-4 slab, and the 14-day processing window strictly from the tool result.
steps.text: आप Week 3-4 slab में हैं, इसलिए आपको 50 percent refund मिलेगा, जिसे process होने में 14 days लगेंगे.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent answers the refund question by grounding all figures (slab, percentage, and days) directly from the check_refund_slab result without any embellishments.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result. Withdrawal refund explained with the slab, percentage and processing window.
